chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin ka lungnopna leh ka kisaktheihna lukhu, ka it ka ngaih ahi ute naute aw, tua bangin Topa sungah kipin om un, ka itte aw!
Eu-odia leh Sintikhe in Topa sungah a lung kituak nadingun ka thuum hi.

Lawm naseppih taktak aw, tua numeite huh dingin ka hong thuum hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in kei leh Klement-a kipan nuntakna laibu sungah min kikhum adang ka naseppihte tawh Lungdamna Thu ka hilh khawmna-ah hong huhin, a hahkat mi ahi uh hi.
Topa sungah lungdam tawntungin om un. Khatvei ka hong genkik-in ah lungdam un!
Mi khempeuh mai-ah na lungsim nemna uh na lak un. Topa hong tun’na a nai zo hi.
Bangmah thu-ah lungmang loin, na khempeuh ah hehpihna phatin na nget nopnate uh Pasian kiangah na ko un.
Tua bang na hih uh leh, kuamah in a tel zawh loh Pasian’ nopna in Khazih Zeisu sungah note lungsim uh leh na ngaihsutnate uh hong keem ding hi.

A khak bel thu in: ute naute aw, thuman thu tawh kipawl nate, zahtakhuai nate, adik nate, a siangtho nate, deihhuai nate, phathuai nate khempeuh ahi zongin, tatna pha khatpeuh peuh, thu phatna khatpeuh peuh tawh a kipawl nate ahi zongin na lungsim sung uhah na ngaihsun un.
Note in nidang lai-in keima kiangah sinin na zaksa, na muhsa, na ngahsa uh nate na zui un, Tua bangin na zuih uh leh, nopna’ Pasian in note tawh hong omkhawm ding hi.
Tu-in zong keimah adingin na phawkkik uh ahih maninah, keimah in Pasian sungah ka lungdam mahmah hi. Ni dangin na hong phawk uh hangin hih theihna thu na ngah kei uh hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin keimah tunga kitangsapna ngaihsunin ci ka hi kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kei in ka thuakna khempeuh ah ka lungkim nadingin ka kisin zo hi.
Simmawhna ahi zongin, hauhna ahi zongin ka thuak thei hi. Ankhamna, gilkialna, sum hauhna, zawn’nate thuak dinginah na khempeuh panin ka kisin zo hi.
Hong thahatsakpa Khazih hangin na khempeuh ka hih thei hi.
Ahih hangin gimna ka thuak lai takin note in kei tawh kizopna hangin a pha-in na bawl zo uh hi.
Lawm Filippi mite aw, Lungdamna Thu hilh ding kipanin Makedonia gam pan ka paikhiat lai takin, piakna leh ngahna in note sim loh kuamah pawlpi in kei tawh a kizom kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Thesalonika khua-ah ka om lai takin ka sapnate note in khatvei nong piak khit uh ciangin, nong piakik lai uh hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin huhna sumpi a zong ka hi hi, a ci ka hi kei hi. Note ading a gah a khan’na bek ka zong hi.
Keimah in na khempeuh ka nei ta a, ka hau hi! Pasian tungah a lungdamhuai, a san’ huai gim namtui biak piakna ahi note’ hong khak huhnate Epafroditas’ khut sung pan ka ngah maninah ka hau hi.
Ka Pasian in ama vangliatna tawh kipawl hauhna a om mah bangin, note kisapna khempeuh Khazih Zeisu sungah hong kicingsak ding hi.
Eite’ Pa leh Pasian tungah a tawntungin minthan’na om tawntung ta hen. Amen.
Khazih Zeisu sungah a om misiangthote khempeuh na hopihsak un. Kei tawh a omkhawm ute naute-a kipan misiangthote in note hong hopih uh hi.
Kaisar kumpipa’ inn sungah a om misiangthote in hong hopih pha diak uh hi.
Topa Zeisu Khazih’ hehpihna thupha in note lungsim kha tawh omkhawm ta hen. Amen.
